item.title: What A Decade Of Living In Paris Has Done To My Beauty Routine
item.description: Monica Ainley always thought “French-girl beauty” was a made-up internet construct. But having spent a decade living in Paris – now with a mussed-up bob and an obsession with “smushy” lipstick – she’ll concede there is something to it. On the eve of Paris Fashion Week, she shares how living in France has changed her approach to skincare and beauty.
